$comment: 14 §1.1 🔒: 'No driver or vendor SDK anywhere outside an adapter ... Enforced
by architecture tests (23 §6) plus a CI check that fails if a vendor
PackageReference appears in more than one .csproj.'
The check treats EVERY PackageReference as a vendor SDK unless it is named
here. That default is deliberate: a new driver must be argued for in a diff
to this file, not slipped in as a transitively-obvious dependency.
What belongs here: test infrastructure and analysers - things that are not a
swappable third-party service behind a port, and therefore cannot lock the
project in. What does NOT belong here: anything that talks to a database, a
cache, an object store, a payment or ad network, a push service, an analytics
backend or a telemetry backend. Those live in exactly one adapter project.
Entries may end in '*' to match a prefix, e.g. 'xunit*'.
